info.name: Discovr Service
info.description:
Beckn Protocol v2.0 — Discovr Service API Collection.

Covers catalog discovery (text search, spatial, JSONPath), catalog push (from Catalg CDS), and health endpoints.

GET /beckn/discover is synchronous (returns catalogs directly).
POST /beckn/discover is asynchronous (returns ACK, delivers on_discover via callback).
POST /catalog/push is fire-and-forget (returns ACK, no callback).

All POST endpoints are auto-signed via pre-request scripts (requires signing service on sign-host).
Identity (subscriberId, recordId) is extracted from the Authorization header.

request.description:
Synchronous text search discovery. Returns matching catalogs directly in the response body.

Searches across resource names, descriptions, and attributes using the configured text search engine (native ES, semantic, or NLWeb).

response.name: Success - Catalogs Found

request.description:
Spatial discovery — find catalogs whose provider is within 1km of a point (HSR Layout, Bengaluru).

Uses S_DWITHIN operator (OGC CQL2) targeting provider.availableAt geo coordinates.

Spatial discovery — find offers whose provider is within 1km of a point (Koramangala, Bengaluru).

Targets offer-level provider locations instead of catalog-level.

JSONPath filter discovery — find resources by a specific manufacturer.

Uses RFC 9535 JSONPath with filter expressions on resourceAttributes fields.

Combined search — text search for "coffee" AND spatial filter for providers within 5km.

Multiple intent fields are ANDed together.

Asynchronous discovery — returns immediate ACK, processes via Kafka.

Results are delivered asynchronously via on_discover callback to the caller's registered URL (resolved from DeDi Registry using subscriberId/recordId from the Authorization header).

Use POST for production workloads; GET is for synchronous testing.
Asynchronous combined discovery — text search + spatial filter, delivered via callback.
